stem: To compute a laptop's stock cover, an analyst averages its weekly sales over the last 4 weeks, including a week in which the laptop was out of stock and sold nothing. Compared with Voltmarkt's convention, what does this do to the stock cover?

options.text: Cover looks shorter than it is, because the weekly rate comes out too high
Cover looks longer than it is, because the weekly rate comes out too low
Cover is unchanged, because a week with no stock adds no sales to the total
Cover is unchanged, because it depends only on the stock on hand today
